---- 
2/14th August, 2024 Heard the learned counsels appearing on behalf of the petitioner as well as the respondent State and the respondent no.10-M/s Adani Group of Companies.

2. The prayer in this petition has been made for direction upon the respondent no.4 to prepare the Award for determination of compensation amount and to make payment of the compensation for the land pertaining to khata no.55, plot no.53, area 0.52 acres and plot no.60, area 1.50 acres totaling to area 2.02 acres in mouza-Gangta, Govindpur, thana no.305, village- Motia, thana-Godda in the district of Godda.

3. Ms. Sudhir Kumar Sharma, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the aforesaid land was acquired for power plant of M/s Adani -1- [W.P.(C) No. 3927 of 2024] Group of Companies for which the learned Commissioner (Santhal Pargana Division), Dumka by order dated 20.06.2022 passed in S.C.A. Case No.40 of 2021-22 by setting aside the order dated 10.08.2021 passed by the Deputy Commissioner, Godda in R.M.A. Case No.65 of 2018 has already made direction to the Deputy Commissioner, Godda for payment of compensation but inadequate compensation has been paid to the petitioner in view of the aforesaid order.
He submits that as per section 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013, the said order has been passed.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The prayer is also made for direction upon the respondent authority for improvement of the land as per section 29 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He submits that Adani Group of Companies has deposited the compensation with the Land Acquisition Officer and the land of the petitioner has been acquired and pursuant to that, the learned Commissioner's order is already there and inspite of that, the compensation has not been paid.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent State submits that it appears that the direction of the learned Commissioner is there and in view of that this petition can be disposed of directing the Land Acquisition Officer, Godda to examine this aspect of the matter and pass appropriate order.

5. Mr. Vikas Pandey, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no.4/Adani Group of Companies (Adani Power Plant) submits that he has not been able to take instruction, however,
he finds from the representation of the petitioner that Adani Group of Companies has already deposited the compensation with the Land Acquisition Officer.

5. In view of above submission of the learned counsels appearing on behalf of the parties and considering that the order of the Divisional Saral Kumar Jha vs State Of Jharkhand on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38283598/
2 -2-

entities.text: Divisional Saral Kumar Jha vs State Of Jharkhand on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Commissioner, Santhal Pargana Division is there in favour of the petitioner and M/s Adani Group of Companies has already deposited the amount of compensation with the Land Acquisition Officer, this petition is being disposed of directing the petitioner to approach the Land Acquisition Officer, Godda by way of filing the credentials with regard to the said claim within a period of three weeks, and if such a credentials/ representation is filed before the Land Acquisition Officer, Godda, he will examine the entire aspect of the matter and the Land Acquisition Officer, Godda will pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of four weeks further thereafter.
It is needless to say that if the decision is taken in favour of the petitioner, the fruit of the same will be provided to the petitioner within four weeks further thereafter.
8. With above direction, this petition is accordingly disposed of.
9. Pending petition if any also stands disposed of accordingly.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.)
